description: Ministry of Tourism - Appointing Ceylon Petroleum Corporation as the Service Provider for the provision of aeronautical services at the aerodromes.
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (Prasanna Ranatunga, Minister of Tourism) and detailed portfolio responsibilities (appointing the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation as Service Provider for aeronautical services at specific airports, with comprehensive terms and conditions outlined in Schedule I).
